record.name: Unfold: AI Stress & Wellness
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Unfold is a general wellness app that helps you reflect on your mood, sleep, activity, and daily routines. With your permission, Unfold can combine journal entries with available Apple Health data to surface patterns and general wellness insights.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Guided journaling: Write or speak your thoughts and use prompts tailored to the information you choose to share.
• Mood and routine tracking: Record how you feel and review changes over time.
• Sleep and activity summaries: View trends based on data available from Apple Health.
• Wellness scores and explanations: See how displayed scores are calculated, with methodology, data sources, and citations inside the app.
• Breathing and focus exercises: Use guided practices to pause, reflect, and wind down.
• Weekly reports: Review summaries of your recent journal and wellness activity.
• Apple Watch companion: Log your mood, view general wellness information, and start supported breathing exercises from your wrist.

AI AND YOUR DATA

Some optional features use AI to generate prompts, summaries, or reflections. Before the first applicable AI request, Unfold explains what data may be sent, identifies the processors involved, and asks for your permission. You can decline or withdraw that permission in Settings.

IMPORTANT HEALTH INFORMATION

Unfold is intended for general wellness and informational purposes only. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Scores, trends, and insights are estimates based on available data and may be incomplete or inaccurate. They show possible patterns or associations, not proven causes or predictions.

Do not use Unfold as a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

Optional subscriptions unlock premium features. Available plans, localized prices, billing periods, and any applicable trial or introductory offer are shown before purchase.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions through your Apple ID settings and restore eligible purchases inside Unfold.

Privacy Policy:
https://tryunfold.ai/privacy

Terms of Use:
https://tryunfold.ai/terms

record.name: HealthBar: AI Wellness RPG
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn your Apple Health data into a daily adventure. See your wellness as HP, buffs, and quests, with optional AI guidance from Master Ronnie.

HealthBar gives everyday health signals a playful RPG twist. Connect Apple Health, choose your character, and make sense of your steps, activity, water, sleep, mood, and recovery through a simple daily HP status.

YOUR WELLNESS, REIMAGINED

• See how your day is going through HP, buffs, debuffs, and small quests.
• Explore trends and insights without getting lost in charts.
• Earn XP, grow your character, and celebrate everyday progress.
• Keep your HP close with Home Screen widgets, Lock Screen widgets, Apple Watch, and complications.
• Set personal goals for movement, active energy, water, and sleep.

OPTIONAL AI WITH MASTER RONNIE

With your permission, get an AI-generated overview of selected wellness patterns and gentle suggestions for your day. Chat with Master Ronnie about general wellness, habits, and—when relevant—selected findings from your own health data. HealthBar processes your HealthKit records on your device and sends selected, derived findings for AI responses, rather than your raw HealthKit history.

BUILT FOR SMALL STEPS

HealthBar helps you notice patterns and choose manageable actions, whether that means taking a walk, drinking water, pausing to breathe, or protecting time for rest. There are no harsh scores or impossible streaks to chase.

HEALTHBAR+

Unlock deeper insights, longer-term patterns, more AI chat, and an ad-free experience.

HealthBar is a wellness companion, not a medical device. It does not provide diagnoses, treatment, or medical advice.

record.name: Welldo: AI Stress Monitor
record.publisher: APP ORIGINS STUDIO YAZILIM ANONIM SIRKETI
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Welldo is a science-based Apple Watch app that monitors real-time stress, HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, and energy to improve overall well-being.

Welldo Stress Tracker helps you understand those signals and turn them into calmer, smarter daily habits. By translating complex health data into clear, human-friendly insights, Welldo shows you when to slow down, recharge, or keep going — without overwhelm.

STRESS TRACKING
Welldo analyzes your Heart Rate Variability (HRV) and Resting Heart Rate from Apple Health to continuously estimate your stress and recovery levels.
Instead of raw numbers or confusing charts, you get:
* Clear stress levels
* Easy-to-read trends
* Meaningful insights you can act on
Whether you’re working late, recovering from poor sleep, feeling mentally drained, or pushing your limits, Welldo helps you recognize stress early — before it turns into burnout.

REAL-TIME STRESS MONITORING — BACKED BY SCIENCE
Your body responds to stress instantly. Welldo tracks those physiological changes throughout the day to give you a real-time view of how your body is coping.
You’ll learn:
* When stress is building
* When your body is recovering
* How daily habits affect your balance
No data overload. Just calm awareness.

UNDERSTAND WHAT TRIGGERS YOUR STRESS
Welldo doesn’t just show how stressed you are — it helps you understand why.
By combining HRV, heart rate, sleep, and activity data, you can:
* Identify stress patterns
* Discover what impacts your recovery most
* Make better decisions for long-term wellbeing
Over time, your data starts telling a clear story — about you.

BODY BATTERY — KNOW HOW MUCH ENERGY YOU HAVE
Welldo’s Body Battery estimates how charged or depleted your body is using stress, recovery, sleep, and activity data.
Your Body Battery helps you understand:
* When your energy is charging
* When it’s draining
* How sleep, stress, and activity affect you over time
Track your energy trends daily, weekly, and monthly — and see how small changes lead to better balance.

BUILT FOR APPLE WATCH
Welldo is designed around an Apple Watch–first experience:
* Monitor stress and Body Battery directly from your wrist
* Use widgets and watch faces for quick, glanceable insights
* Stay aware without constantly checking your phone
Your wellness companion is always with you.

FEATURES
* Real-time HRV-based stress tracking
* Body Battery energy score
* Sleep, activity & recovery insights
* Activity Tracking
* Apple Watch widgets & watch face support
* Stress notifications & alerts
* Daily, weekly & monthly trends
* Full Apple Health integration
* Privacy-first design

DATA & PRIVACY
Welldo reads data directly from Apple Health. Your health data stays private, secure, and under your control — always.

IMPORTANT HEALTH DISCLAIMER
Welldo Stress Tracker is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice or diagnosis. If you experience chronic or excessive stress, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICES AND TERMS
Welldo is free to download, with optional Welldo Pro subscriptions available on a monthly or annual basis. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple ID settings, and any free trial will automatically convert to a paid subscription unless canceled before it ends.

LEARN MORE
Privacy Policy: https://www.Welldoapp.co/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://www.Welldoapp.co/terms-and-conditions

Unlock Your Personalized Health Blueprint with Thryve.

Tired of generic stats? Thryve analyzes your Apple Health data privately on your device to give you deep, actionable insights and truly personalized guidance. Stop guessing, start optimizing!

- Your personal data is encrypted and securely stored
- We never sell or share your data
- You remain in full control of your information at all times

InnerHeal is designed to support mental wellness, self-care, and emotional reflection.
It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment and is not a replacement for professional mental health care.

InnerHeal makes mental health simple, personalized, and supportive - every single day.

record.name: AI Wellness Hub
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
AI Wellness Hub is the daily wellness app for women who want a real coach in their pocket — not another habit tracker that ghosts you when life gets messy.

When you sign up you're matched with a real coach who can actually see your check-ins, message you when you hit a streak, and adjust your plan when you need it. No bots. No fake encouragement. A person who has your back.

DAILY CHECK-INS — Three things, every day: protein, water, movement. Tap to close the rings. Easy. Done.

REAL CHALLENGES — Start with the 7-Day Two Shakes Challenge auto-enrolled at signup. Then graduate into Hit Your Protein, Daily Steps, Water Challenge, or a community 30-Day group challenge.

YOUR COACH, IN-APP — Built-in chat with your coach. They see your check-ins on their side. They know when you're on Day 12 and crushing it. They know when you're on Day 3 of low mood. They reach out first.

RECIPES + PLAN — Quick recipes for shakes, drinks, and snacks. Your coach builds your daily structure, you follow it. Edit anytime.

PROGRESS PHOTOS — Private by default. Yours. Choose what to share with your coach.

APPLE HEALTH — Sync your steps, workouts, and weight. AI Wellness Hub uses your existing data, you don't log twice.

MOOD CHECK — A 1-tap daily mood. Your coach notices patterns you don't.

STREAKS THAT MOTIVATE — Not the fake-pressure kind. The "look how far you've come" kind.

CYCLE-AWARE (optional) — Track wellness alongside your cycle if you want. Off by default.

WHO IT'S FOR
Women in their 20s-50s who want better daily habits with someone walking the path with them.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with Apple or email
2. Tell us about you (under a minute)
3. Enter your coach's ID (your coach gives you this)
4. Get auto-enrolled in your first 7-day challenge
5. Daily check-ins, daily coaching, daily progress

PRIVACY
Your data is yours. Encrypted in transit. Visible only to you and the coach you choose. Never sold. Never shared with advertisers. Delete your account anytime.

SUPPORT
support@rebecca-louise.com — usually replies within a few hours.

Why Choose Emily?

- Mindful Conversations: Emily helps you reconnect with your inner self, guiding you through soothing, thoughtful conversations that encourage peace and self-awareness.
- Real-Time Emotional Support: When stress or anxiety hits, Emily is there to offer real-time advice, designed to help you feel grounded and in control.
- Reduce Stress & Anxiety: Emily offers personalized support to help you navigate life’s ups and downs.
- Serenity on Demand: Whenever you need a moment of calm or emotional clarity, Emily is just a tap away—helping you cultivate mindfulness, balance, and a peaceful mindset.
- Your Journey to Emotional Wellness: Emily empowers you to track your emotional well-being and build lasting habits that promote serenity and self-care.

Imagine having a personal guide who listens without judgment, offers encouragement, and helps you slow down when life feels fast. Emily’s mindful prompts and compassionate conversations bring you back to a place of calm, even during your busiest days. From quick moments of reflection to more in-depth emotional support, Emily is here to remind you to breathe, reflect, and grow.

Find your peace with Emily—whether you’re navigating a stressful situation, looking for emotional clarity, or simply want a moment of mindfulness to start or end your day.

record.name: Ripple: Smart Health Journal
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Have you ever felt like something’s off but can’t quite figure out why? Random insomnia, sudden acne breakouts, or even a skin rash that comes and goes. Or maybe stress, depression, or anxiety are making some days extra challenging. You might suspect your food, daily habits, or even that time you petted a cat could be affecting you, but without tracking, how can you know for sure? Trigger Journal—the ultimate mood journal, symptom tracker and daily habit tracker, designed to help you uncover the root causes of your conditions so you can take charge of your mental health and physical well-being!

With Trigger Journal, logging daily activities is simple. Track your food, physical activities, mood, products you use & more. You can log as often as you like, so every detail is captured. Feeling good? Log it. Not feeling so great? Log it, too! From food intake to cleaning products, every action you record becomes part of a larger picture of your physical & emotional health.

Trigger Journal covers a wide range of conditions you might deal with — skin rash, insomnia, allergies, stress, mood swings, anxiety & food intolerances. It’s your personal symptom tracker for both physical & mental health.

AI analysis finds meaningful patterns across your logs. We go beyond the obvious to help you find possible links between actions and conditions:

	•	Ingredient Analysis: The app can look for specific ingredients in what you eat or drink—like gluten, dairy, animal fats, sugar, or caffeine—and check if they’re associated with any symptoms you log
	•	Product Tracking: Logging cosmetics, cleaning products & other household items? Trigger Journal analyzes their ingredients to help you spot potential irritants or allergens that might be affecting your skin, mood, or mental & emotional health
	•	Timing & Frequency: Are conditions flaring up at specific times of the day? The app tracks when you log each action, so you can see if morning coffee, late-night snacks, or midday workouts might be playing a role. We also check if repeating an activity affects your symptoms
	•	Delayed Effects: Some symptoms don’t show up right away—like a insomnia the day after a stressful event or a skin rash hours after a certain meal. Trigger Journal looks for patterns over time, tracking symptoms & triggers across multiple days to help you spot delayed reactions

With Trigger Journal you get access to an AI-powered tool that’s like having a detective for your health. This isn’t just a symptom tracker; it’s a self-care tool for understanding stressors & patterns affecting your physical & mental well-being. Get insights on mood, emotional health and tips for managing stress & symptoms. The more you log, the better the insights.

Features:

	•	Daily Logging: Track actions multiple times a day—from meals & physical activities to mood, stress & interactions with pets
	•	Mood Journal & Self-Care Tracker: Track your emotional health, daily habits & more. Log and track conditions, symptoms & triggers
	•	Personalized Insights: Receive customized insights unique to your lifestyle, habits & sensitivities
	•	Smart Suggestions: Get tips on managing your conditions & additional triggers to watch out for

So, if you’re tired of wondering if your daily routine is affecting how you feel, give us a try. Take charge of your physical & emotional health and begin your journey to feeling better with Trigger Journal!

Trigger Journal isn’t here to replace medical advice or counseling. Our insights are meant to guide you toward understanding possible connections & patterns—not to diagnose or treat conditions. Think of it as a personal health tool that empowers you to make informed decisions, understand your body & mind better & even bring helpful insights to share with healthcare or counseling professionals.

Support service email: support@triggerjournal.app

Terms and Conditions: https://triggerjournal.app/terms-conditions.html

record.name: Therabody
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The Therabody app gives you personalized guidance on how to recover faster, enhance athletic performance, reduce tension, and even sleep better with your Therabody products. Based on your unique needs, activity tracking, and now with Coach: Intelligent recovery planning designed to help you perform – and feel – better every day. 

Once you pair with a compatible Theragun massage gun, SmartGoggles eye and temple massager, SleepMask, RecoveryAir or JetBoots compression pants, WaveRoller, WaveDuo, WaveSolo muscle rollers, ThermBack LED advanced back wrap, or TheraFace PRO LED light and microcurrent facial device, you can start moving towards your fitness, wellness, and skincare goals. 


A COACH IN YOUR POCKET 

Powered by AI, Coach by Therabody creates intelligent, personalized recovery plans based on your fitness goals, activity data, and latest scientific research. Designed for Theragun, Coach updates your recovery plan daily with your activities and changing needs. It notifies you in real-time with customized, science-backed recommendations to help you use your Theragun for more effective recovery. 


ACTIVITY TRACKING AND WEARABLES SYNCING 

Record activities using your favorite health and fitness wearable devices or apps. You can track runs, walks, hikes, bike rides, workouts, yoga, and dozens more. Just sync the Therabody app with your favorite device including Garmin, Apple Health and Strava, and your activities from your connected wearables will sync in real-time so that you have the most effective recovery plan based on your day. 


MASSAGE GUN TRACKING 

Theragun is the only massage gun that syncs your recovery data to a fitness app in real time — tracking therapy types, session length and speed, even when you’re not using the app*. That means you’ll always get credit for your recovery sessions and receive personalized recommendations tailored to your routine.   


GUIDED ROUTINES DESIGNED BY EXPERTS 

Eliminate any guesswork and explore our library of step-by-step guided routines that show exactly how to use your device, where to use it on your body, and for how long. From recovering your legs after a long run, to relieving that pesky back pain after a long workday, you’ll find the treatment you need, designed by our team of science and physiology experts including physical therapists, trainers, chiropractors, and scientists. 


BLUETOOTH CONNECTIVITY FOR ADVANCED CONTROLS 

With Bluetooth connectivity, use the Therabody app to fine-tune your settings with more precise control. Adjust the exact speed of your Theragun, tweak the heat on your SmartGoggles, adjust the LED light for your TheraFace PRO, or soften the vibration of your Wave Roller to provide your body what feels best. Plus, routines will automatically apply any recommended settings and tell you when to switch positions or attachments. 


*Offline session tracking only available for Theragun PRO Plus, Theragun Prime Plus, Theragun Sense (1st and 2nd Gen), Theragun Prime 6th Gen, and Theragun Mini 3rd Gen.

record.name: MeYouMe Ai Macro Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your AI-powered health companion that makes nutrition tracking effortless and personal.

MeYouMe combines smart food logging with a conversational AI coach to help you build healthier habits without the hassle. Whether you type, talk, snap a photo, or scan a barcode, logging your meals takes seconds, not minutes. No complicated interfaces, no guessing games with portion sizes. Just you, your Coach, and a smarter way to take care of yourself.

SMART FOOD LOGGING — 5 WAYS TO LOG
-Search from over 5,000 foods with accurate, verified nutrition data. Every food comes with real serving sizes pulled straight from a professional nutrition database, so when you see "1 medium apple" or "1 cup of rice," you know the calories and macros are spot on.
-Scan any barcode and get instant product nutrition pulled from a global food database. No typing, no searching. Just point your camera and go.
-Snap a photo of your plate and let your AI Coach identify what you ate. It works with home-cooked meals, restaurant plates, and packaged foods. Your Coach breaks down the calories, protein, carbs, and fat from what it sees.
-Use your voice to describe what you ate in natural language. Say something like "I had a chicken salad with avocado for lunch" and your Coach handles the rest. No menus, no dropdowns. Just talk.
Or go fully manual. Enter your own food name and nutrition values when you want complete control over what gets logged.

YOUR PERSONAL AI COACH
-Your Coach is always ready to chat. Ask about nutrition, get feedback on your food choices, or just check in about how your day is going. Every time you log a meal, your Coach gives you a quick, honest insight about your choice and how it fits into your daily goals.
-Your Coach learns your patterns and gives you tips that actually make sense for your lifestyle. It is not a generic chatbot reading from a script. It is a real conversation partner that remembers your goals, understands your preferences, and keeps things casual and supportive.

COMPLETE DAILY TRACKING
-Track calories, protein, carbs, and fat with clean visual progress bars that show exactly where you stand for the day. See how each meal contributes to your daily targets and make smarter choices throughout the day.
-Stay hydrated with water tracking and customizable daily goals. Hit your target and get a little celebration. Track your intermittent fasting with a built-in timer that saves your session history so you can see your fasting streaks over time.
-Log your weight and watch your trends. Check in with your mood to start connecting how you feel with what you eat and how you move. Log your exercise and see how your workouts fit into your daily calorie picture.
-Everything you log shows up on a beautiful timeline, giving you a complete view of your entire day at a glance.

BEAUTIFUL AND PERSONAL
-Choose your vibe. MeYouMe comes with multiple color themes so the app feels like yours. Switch between light and dark mode whenever you want. Get daily tips, wellness insights, and helpful nudges that keep you motivated without being annoying.
-Your Today screen brings everything together in one place: nutrition progress, water intake, fasting status, mood, exercise, and your AI Coach. It is your daily health dashboard, designed to be glanced at in seconds.

BUILT FOR YOUR PRIVACY
-Your health data is personal and it stays that way. MeYouMe does not sell your data, does not show you ads, and does not share your information with third parties. What you track is yours and yours alone.
-Start your journey to better health with a companion that actually understands you. Your Coach is ready when you are.
